title: Mead Farm
specs: One of the oldest horse riding establishments in Stamford since 1928
Experienced instructors providing comprehensive riding and horsemanship instruction
New students must take a private 1/2 hour lesson to assess riding ability
Approved original waiver packet required before first lesson
All students must wear jeans or long pants and hard soled shoes/boots with slight heel
New riders can borrow helmet for first lesson; own equipment required thereafter
Trail riding only for experienced riders able to walk, trot, and canter; minimum age 12
Group parties available at $85 per person

blurb: Mead Farm offers private and group horseback riding lessons, trail rides for experienced riders, horsemanship classes, and seasonal programs including summer day camps and birthday parties. Instruction focuses on building riding skills and horsemanship in a safe, educational, and fun environment. Boarding and horse care services are also available.
